subject.title: fix(state): stop Voice Wake migration conflict startup loops

question: Should conflicting legacy Voice Wake JSON be automatically archived after canonical SQLite state is preserved, changing affected upgrades from repeat startup refusal to automatic recovery?
rationale: This is a persistent-state migration policy choice with availability and recovery consequences for existing installations; the patch is narrow, but maintainers must confirm the intended upgrade contract rather than infer it from tests alone.

options.title: Accept automatic convergence
options.body: Approve SQLite-authoritative migration with owner-only legacy receipts after current-head foreground Gateway proof confirms first- and second-start recovery.

options.title: Keep conflict fail-closed
options.body: Retain the existing startup refusal until an operator explicitly resolves divergent legacy and SQLite Voice Wake state.

options.title: Require a different recovery surface
options.body: Pause this PR and define a Doctor-led confirmation or recovery workflow before changing startup behavior for persisted conflicts.

recommendation.title: Accept automatic convergence
recommendation.body: Approve SQLite-authoritative migration with owner-only legacy receipts after current-head foreground Gateway proof confirms first- and second-start recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: No feature-history owner could be established from the supplied material; route through the normal state-migration and Gateway review owners.
